module: UI livery editor (paint/decals) orchestrator. It relies on the editor API `editor_api_dynamicDecals`: on opening it stores the player vehicle's current skin, enables the `dynamicTextures` skin, prepares the layer stack (blank livery in the vehicle's color or existing save) and starts the camera. On closing it restores the original skin.
usage:
ui_liveries.setup()          -- blank livery
ui_liveries.setup('maSauvegarde') -- loads a save
-- ...
ui_liveries.teardown()
notes: setup returns true without doing anything if the editor is already running; returns false if the decals API is missing.
The value returned by setup is the success of loading the layer stack (false if the save could not be loaded: a blank livery is then created anyway).
The live decal cursor is only displayed when the transform screen requests it (setProjectDynamicDecalsState(false) at startup).

setup.desc: Starts the livery editor on the player vehicle (dynamicTextures skin, layers, history cleared, camera).

saveName.desc: Name of a save to load; nil = blank livery in the vehicle's color.

returns.desc: true if the layer stack was initialized correctly.

teardown.desc: Stops the editor: camera, API deactivation, restoring the previous skin and cleaning up the fill. No effect if not started.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame by the extension system; calls api.onUpdate_() while the editor is running.

isRunning.desc: Returns whether the livery editor is active.
